prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-05-14, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-05-14):
Price action as of 2026-05-14: 1w +2.7%, 1m +11.6%, 3m +25.7%. Last close 248.82. 21d annualized realized volatility 41%. Position in trailing 63-day range: 83% (0%=low, 100%=high).
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock has delivered strong multi-period momentum (notably +11.6% over the past month) while sitting at the upper end of its trailing 63-day range, which is consistent with trend continuation over a roughly one-month horizon. At the same time the 83% range position plus 41% realized volatility indicate the move is extended and susceptible to consolidation or modest reversal. On balance the technical backdrop supports a neutral stance rather than a fresh directional bet.
DECISION: HOLD
